Error.description: Bad request, not found or server error. See `code`.

BlameItem.description: The commit that last changed one line.

BlobResponse.description: `GET /blob`. `text` and `total_lines` are null for a binary file.

CheckpointItem.description: One checkpoint of the uncommitted work.

auto.description: Taken by Mark all viewed (`review.has_auto_checkpoint`), not by the Checkpoint button.

bytes.description: Bytes of file copies the checkpoint still holds.

files_omitted.description:
The scan of the working tree stopped at `limits.worktree_files`, so the checkpoint may
not hold every changed file. Raise the limit and take another checkpoint.

id.description: `cp-` and 12 hex digits of the hash of the state: the same state is the same id.

cap_bytes.description: `review.checkpoint_mb` in bytes. 0 means checkpoints are off.

persisted.description:
False when checkpoints cannot be kept: there is no writable cache folder, a newer build
owns it, or the cap is 0.

truncated.description: The diff was cut at the line cap.

CompareResponse.description: `GET /compare`: the files that differ between two revisions.

from.description:
The commit the head was compared from: `base`, or the merge base of `base` and `head`
for a three-dot compare.

truncated.description: The diff was cut at the line cap.

first_time.description: The first commit ever falls inside the counted window. Never for the whole history.

bus_factor.description: The fewest people who made half the commits.

DiffHunk.description: A run of changed lines under one header.

DiffLine.description: One line of a diff hunk.

returns.description: The top-level fields of the answer.

authors_90d.description: People with a counted change in the 90 days before the newest commit.

bus_factor.description: People who together hold half the knowledge, 0 when no counted change.

hot.description: In the top tenth of files by hotspot score: the hotspots page's own rule.

partners.description: Top 3 by commits in common, files only.

FileInsightAge.description: When the path last changed and how old its lines are.

last_change.description: Author time of the newest counted change, null when there is none.

median_line_age_secs.description:
Median age of the lines now in seconds, from blame. Null for a directory, a file
that is not in the tree and a file blame cannot read.

FileInsightChild.description: A direct child of a directory card, for a tree badge.

hot.description: In the top tenth of files by hotspot score.

rank.description: 1-based by hotspot score, the best file under a directory. 0 when not ranked.

FileInsightChurn.description: How much the path changed in the period.

lines_changed.description: Added plus removed lines in the period.

of.description: Ranked files: 0 when the path is not ranked.

rank.description: 1-based by hotspot score, for a directory its best file. 0 when not ranked.

series.description: Changes per bucket over the period, oldest first, 12 buckets.

FileInsightKind.description: What the path is at the revision.

oneOf.description: Not a text file or a directory of the tree: the card is empty, not an error.

FileInsightOwner.description: One person's share of the path's knowledge.

FileInsightPartner.description: A file that changes in the same commits as the card's file.

degree.description: `together / min(changes of the two files)`, 0 to 1.

hunks.description: Absent unless the request asked for the diff.

Finding.description: One entry of the review basket.

id.description: `f-` and 8 hex digits of the hash of the entry.

note.description: Why it matters, at most 2000 bytes. Plain text: no markup, escaped wherever it is shown.

rev.description: The revision the page was showing.

sha.description: The full commit id the finding is pinned to.

FindingAnchor.description: Where the code a finding points at is now, worked out on every read.

checked_against.description: `head`, or `worktree` when the uncommitted changes were taken into account.

now_lines.description: Only when the status is `untouched` and the lines moved: where the same lines are now.

now_path.description: The path now, after following renames. Null when the file is gone.

status.description:
What happened to the code: `untouched`, `lines changed`, `file changed` or `file gone`.
It never says whether the finding was dealt with.

FindingLines.description: A range of lines, 1-based and inclusive.

cap_entries.description: `review.findings_entries`: the basket drops its oldest entry past this.

persisted.description:
False when the basket cannot be kept: there is no writable cache folder or a newer build
owns it.

InsightCoupling.description: `coupling`: files that change together, for one file or the whole tree.

cross_dir.description: Whether pairs across directories are listed, not only siblings.

matrix.description: Top-level directory pairs, empty when `path` is set.

max_commit_files.description: Commits that changed more files than this are left out.

path.description: The focus file, null for the whole tree.

skipped_commits.description: Commits left out for changing more than `max_commit_files` files.

InsightCouplingPair.description: One pair of `coupling`: two files that changed in the same commits.

cross_dir.description: The two files sit in different directories.

last_together.description: Author time of the newest commit that changed both, unix seconds.

InsightData.description: The `data` of an insight answer. Which variant it is follows from `insight`.

InsightDirChurn.description: One row of `dir_churn`, `.` for files at the repository root.

bus_factor.description: People who together hold at least half of the knowledge.

InsightDirPair.description: Commits that changed files of both top-level directories, `coupling`.

lines_changed.description: Added plus removed lines in the period.

concentration.description: Share of all changes that hit the top 10% of files.

InsightKnowledgeRisk.description: `knowledge_risk`: who holds each directory, and the files nobody active holds.

dirs.description: The children of `path` one level down, largest first.

orphan_files.description: Orphans under the path, all of them, not only those listed.

InsightLanguages.description: `languages`: every line of the text files of the tree at `rev`, per language.

languages.description: Most lines first, ties by name.

total_lines.description: The sum of `languages`, the size of the project.

InsightOrphan.description: A file of `knowledge_risk` whose main authors are all idle.

last_change.description: Author time of the newest counted change, unix seconds.

InsightOwner.description: One person's share of a directory.

InsightPeriod.description: The reporting window as the summary writes it: the variant name, not the canonical text.

InsightPeriodSummary.description: `summary`: the period against the one right before it.

share.description: The person's share of the changes to the file, 0 to 1.

InsightResponse.description: `GET /insights/{name}`. The fields keep the order the answer was always written in.

query.description:
The filter the numbers were counted under, as canonical text: `q` and the one-key
parameters read into one, so a client sees how its request was understood.

InsightRhythm.description: `activity`: when work happens, in each commit's own timezone.

at_risk.description: One person holds half of it and is not active: `bus_factor` 1 and `owner_active` false.

bus_factor.description: People who together hold at least half of the knowledge.

last_active.description: Author time of the top owner's newest commit, unix seconds.

owner_active.description: The top owner committed within the 12 months before the newest commit.

top_share.description: The top owner's share of the directory, 0 to 1.

files.description: Files where this person is the top owner.

last_active.description: Author time of the person's newest commit, unix seconds.

share_of_repo.description: `lines` over the lines of every tracked file, 0 to 1.

InsightSeriesPoint.description: One bucket of the activity series.

LogCommit.description: One commit of a log page.

ParamDoc.description: One query parameter of an endpoint.

PlanFile.description: One changed file and why it sits where it does.

bus_factor_one.description: One person alone holds half the knowledge of the file.

hotspot.description: Null without a counted touch or outside the head tree.

size_lines.description: Lines of the file after the change.

sole_owner.description: The top owner holds at least 80 percent.

PlanHotspot.description: Where a file ranks among the hotspots of the head tree.

PlanOwner.description: One person's share of a file.

PlanSkipped.description: A changed file that is not scored.

PlanSource.description: Where the changed files come from.

PlanTerms.description: The points of `risk`, each named. `risk` is exactly their sum.

churn.description: 0 to 30: the hotspot rank, 30 for the hottest file.

ownership.description: 0 to 25: 25 for a sole owner, 12 for a bus factor of one.

size.description: 0 to 25: lines added and removed against `limits.diff_fold_lines`.

untested.description: 0 to 20: a source file with no test next to it.

RepoTotals.description:
Commits, authors, files and lines over the whole history. Every field but `every_commits`
counts the counted commits.

commits.description: The counted commits: no merges, bots as the options say.

every_commits.description: Every reachable commit, merges and bots included: the overview's "N commits".

base.description:
The commit the changes are against. With `since`, the commit the checkpoint was taken
at, or the current HEAD when `baseline_missing`.

baseline_missing.description:
With `since`: the checkpoint's commit is not in this repository, so files it did not
list were compared with the current HEAD and the plan may miss changes in between.
False otherwise.

content_gone.description:
With `since`: files whose checkpoint copy was dropped (binary, too large), listed
against HEAD instead. Empty otherwise.

files_omitted.description:
Working tree only: the scan stopped at `limits.worktree_files`, so the plan may not
cover every changed file and `total_files` may be low. Raise the limit to cover more.
Not the same as `truncated`, which is about scored rows cut at `limit`.

skipped.description: Files with no risk, in path order.

total_files.description: Changed files in all, scored and skipped.

truncated.description: More scored files than `limit`: the rest are left out of `files`.

SkipReason.description: Why a file has no risk and sorts after every scored file.

oneOf.description: Over `limits.worktree_diff_kb` or the text limit: never read, so never scored.

patch.description: 16 hex digits of the hash of the file's diff. The mark holds only while it matches.

path.description: The path as at the working tree tip.

baseline_missing.description:
Only with `since`: the checkpoint's HEAD is not in this repository (reset, gc, another
clone), so the files it did not list were compared with the current HEAD and commits in
between may be missed.

content_gone.description: Only with `since`: files whose checkpoint copy is gone, diffed against HEAD instead.

files_omitted.description:
The scan of the working tree stopped at `limits.worktree_files` (or, with `since`, so
did the checkpoint's): `files` may not list every changed file. Raise the limit to see
more. This is about files, `truncated` is about diff lines.

history_unreadable.description:
Only with `since`: the commits between the checkpoint and HEAD could not be read (a
missing or unreadable tree), so files only they changed may be missing.

since.description: Only with `since`: the checkpoint the files are compared with.

truncated.description: The diff was cut at the line cap.

unchanged_files.description: Only with `since`: files that read the same as in the checkpoint, left out of `files`.
